experiment: Zero ablation of L3-T1372 at input and generated child tokens on two spelling prompts

features.label: Token "child" in personal or familial contexts

gate_method: raw = standardized pre_norm residual dot encoder row + bias; g = raw if raw > released theta and raw > 0, else 0.
native_computation: Native model retained. Subtract the current natural estimated L3-T1372 contribution at selected child tokens from layer 3 native raw MLP output. Other positions remain byte-identical at that intervention boundary. Normal attention and downstream computation continue.
timing: Editing a generated child token while processing it can affect subsequent tokens. It cannot alter the already emitted child token. Uppercase baseline emits no child, so its two nonzero ablation conditions should agree.
resource: Reuse retained SPAR instance 56698356; separate directory and process; no new rental or lifecycle changes.
scope: Two exact existing prompts; source child at position 27 plus any generated token whose decoded text, stripped of surrounding whitespace and case-folded, equals child. Compare native, zero-strength, input-only, and input-plus-generated conditions. No edits to CH/ch answer tokens, other layers, or strength search.
intervention: native_MLP_output[token] -= removal_fraction * natural_gate_1372(token) * ((z_token @ V_1372) @ U_1372) * output_std_3. Recompute from the current trajectory at every eligible token; use FP32 delta and cast edited output to BF16.
scoring: Actual greedy generation plus separate teacher-forced baseline continuation replays. Lowercase conditional score is P( ch | child:), with generated child also ablated in the input-plus-generated condition.
controls: Unhooked native and zero-strength hook must reproduce saved baseline tokens/probabilities. Input-only must reproduce prior intervention results. Uppercase input-only and input-plus-generated should agree if neither generates child. These are implementation controls, not active norm-matched specificity controls.
limits: Subtraction removes an estimated component from the native MLP while preserving its other computation, including its reconstruction remainder. No full MOLT replacement or claim of complete task necessity. No matched active controls or CH-probe component tests in this pilot.
generated_token_matching: Match a processed response token if tokenizer.decode([token]).strip().casefold() == child. After generation, independently audit decoded whole-word child occurrences against token spans; require every occurrence to be covered by such matching tokens. Abort rather than silently omit a split or punctuation-attached occurrence.
